newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on lower dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on lower dollar demand.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher on Saturday against its U.S. counterpart as dealers saw little commercial demand for the greenback during the shortened session.
The local unit ended at T$27.487 against Friday's T$27.489 close.
Turnover through dealers was a light US$74 million in Saturday's abbreviated session.
"Saturday trading is usually very lacklustre, and today was no exception," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.48-50 range was seen for Monday.-Kevin Chen(5080815)
